problem:
Given 
$M=[\begin{aligned}1 & 3 & 0 \\ 9 & 2 & 1 \\ 7 & 6 & 4\end{aligned}]$,
which of the following elementary row operations makes ${a}_{32}=0?$
worked_solution:
Of the given options, we consider the row operation 

$$
{R}_{3}:={R}_{3}+(-3){R}_{2}.
$$

Applying the above row operation, we obtain the following:

$$
\begin{aligned}M & =[\begin{aligned}1 & 3 & 0 \\ 9 & 2 & 1 \\ 7 & 6 & 4\end{aligned}]\,{R}_{3}:={R}_{3}+(-3)\cdot {R}_{2} \\  & ∼[\begin{aligned}1 & 3 & 0 \\ 9 & 2 & 1 \\ -20 & 0 & 1\end{aligned}]\end{aligned}
$$

 

Therefore, the required row operation is

$$
{R}_{3}:={R}_{3}+(-3){R}_{2}.
$$
